Width units say width source measured, bankfull wetted width interchangeable. parameter habitat-model parameter row bears , one model's names, blank. kind says sort number row : parameter someone chose, habitat-suitability breakpoint, largest value observed, statistic fish found, preference, expert opinion, laboratory hatchery measurement (lab: lethal limit, CTmax, survival growth held temperatures, development time degree-days), qualitative statement, none, search found nothing. quote_source says quote can checked PDF: running text, table cell (checked numbers), ocr scan text layer. abstract fallback work whose PDF : quote checked publisher's abstract, held reference item's abstract, carries page. abstract states less paper (often body length measured, ), row resting one says abstract says. scale grain value measured : redd microhabitat site, surveyed reach, model segment, network summary; site value reach cutoff.

Air temperature variable models use proxy water temperature, two interchangeable. discharge stream size: flow statistic used say big channel , usually mean annual discharge (MAD), filter intrinsic-potential model applies, sometimes summer flow used way. instream_flow flow need: water life stage needs stream, stage's window knw_timing_read() places year. two interchangeable, two instream_flow takes metric, statistic flow held (instantaneous flow, daily monthly mean, monthly median, 7day_low average). need written fraction MAD percent MAD, fits variable. need written point flow distribution percentile (90th percentile high flow) percent exceedance (Q95, flow exceeded 95 % time, low one); two run opposite directions, unit says source used, metric flows ranked. 7day_low row gives return period (7Q2, 7Q10) note. flow need model's stream-size filter, carries parameter model_id, *_mad_* parameters belong discharge rows alone. depth velocity fish meets site (redd, passage riffle, rearing position), unit source wrote (cm, ft, cm/s, ft/s well m m/s). channel's bankfull depth stream size, written m bankfull. fish_length body length source ties survival recruitment (age-0 fish's size onset first winter, say), habitat dimension. reads mm, metric says length source measured: fork_length, total_length, unstated. groundwater covers upwelling, hyporheic exchange springs. takes unit, groundwater row carries value: source read far gives upwelling measure (vertical hydraulic gradient, say).

title: knowledge 0.4.0
text: New evidence variable instream_flow: flow need, water life stage needs stream, kept apart discharge, stream size (usually MAD intrinsic-potential model filters ). takes m3/s, cfs, percent MAD, percentile percent exceedance, metric naming flow statistic held (instantaneous, daily_mean, 7day_low, monthly_mean, monthly_median, unstated). carries parameter model_id, *_mad_* parameters now sit discharge rows . 7day_low row needs note giving return period. depth velocity read unit source wrote: cm ft depth, cm/s ft/s velocity, well m m/s. channel’s bankfull depth stream size reads m bankfull. Rows changed variable unit, filter old values returns fewer rows: data row 121 (migration low flow, now instream_flow coded SALMON), rows 250, 257 264 (bankfull depths, now m bankfull), rows 497 498 (redd velocities, now cm/s quoted).

New evidence variables degree_days (degC-day) air_temperature (degC). Air temperature variable intrinsic-potential models use proxy water temperature. cited degree_days row needs note giving base temperature. none row may carry bound, naming limit searched . New kind lab: laboratory hatchery measurement (lethal limit, CTmax, survival growth held temperatures, development time degree-days), expert opinion. qual row refused value: statement, value counted evidence .
